technical-summary: PWR07 slice 1: portable read-only CPU power probe (cpufreq policies, EPP, boost/turbo, pstate, cpuidle, powercap/amd_energy counters) with injectable sysfs root and platform; Observation status/reason model; fake-sysfs tests for Intel/AMD/VM/Windows/permission failures.
user-summary-candidate: Added a portable, read-only CPU power probe that works across Intel, AMD, VMs and non-Linux hosts and reports why anything is unavailable.
